options.content:
- Use Cases: This dashboard shows the basic project management metrics from Jira.
- Data Source Required: Jira

panels.description:
1. Total number of issues created.
2. The requirements being calculated are filtered by "requirement creation time" (time filter at the upper-right corner) and "Jira board" ("Choose Board" filter at the upper-left corner)

targets.rawSql:
select 
  count(distinct i.id) as value
from issues i
  join board_issues bi on i.id = bi.issue_id
where 
  i.type in (${type})
  and $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
  and bi.board_id in (${board_id})

panels.title: Number of Issues [Issues Created in Selected Time Range]

targets.rawSql:
select 
  count(distinct i.id) as value
from issues i
  join board_issues bi on i.id = bi.issue_id
where 
  i.type in (${type})
  and i.status = 'DONE'
  and $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
  and bi.board_id in (${board_id})

panels.title: Number of Delivered Issue [Issues Created in Selected Time Range]

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(i.created_date, '$__interval') as time,
  count(distinct case when status != 'DONE' then i.id else null end) as "Number of Open Issues",
  count(distinct case when status = 'DONE' then i.id else null end) as "Number of Delivered Issues"
FROM issues i
	join board_issues bi on i.id = bi.issue_id
	join boards b on bi.board_id = b.id
where 
  i.type in (${type})
  and $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
  and bi.board_id in (${board_id})
group by 1

panels.title: Issue Status Distribution over Selected Time Range [Issues Created in Selected Time Range]

targets.rawSql:
with _requirements as(
  select
    count(distinct i.id) as total_count,
    count(distinct case when i.status = 'DONE' then i.id else null end) as delivered_count
  from issues i
    join board_issues bi on i.id = bi.issue_id
  where 
    i.type in (${type})
    and $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
    and bi.board_id in (${board_id})
)

select 
  now() as time,
  1.0 * delivered_count/total_count as requirement_delivery_rate
from _requirements

panels.title: Issue Delivery Rate [Issues Created in Selected Time Range]

targets.rawSql:
with _requirements as(
  select
    $__timeGroup(i.created_date, '$__interval') as time,
    1.0 * count(distinct case when i.status = 'DONE' then i.id else null end)/count(distinct i.id) as delivered_rate
  from issues i
    join board_issues bi on i.id = bi.issue_id
  where 
    i.type in (${type})
    and $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
    and bi.board_id in (${board_id})
  group by 1
)

select
  time,
  delivered_rate
from _requirements
order by time

panels.title: Issue Delivery Rate over Time [Issues Created in Selected Time Range]

targets.rawSql:
select 
  avg(lead_time_minutes/1440) as value
from issues i
  join board_issues bi on i.id = bi.issue_id
where 
  i.type in (${type})
  and i.status = 'DONE'
  and $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
  and bi.board_id in (${board_id})

panels.title: Mean Issue Lead Time in Days [Issues Resolved in Select Time Range]

targets.rawSql:
with _ranks as(
  select 
    i.lead_time_minutes,
    percent_rank() over (order by lead_time_minutes asc) as ranks
  from issues i
    join board_issues bi on i.id = bi.issue_id
  where 
    i.type in (${type})
    and i.status = 'DONE'
    and $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
    and bi.board_id in (${board_id})
)

select
  max(lead_time_minutes/1440) as value
from _ranks
where 
  ranks <= 0.8

panels.title: 80% Issues' Lead Time are less than # days [Issues Resolved in Select Time Range]

targets.rawSql:
with _requirements as(
  select 
    $__timeGroup(i.resolution_date, '$__interval') as time,
    avg(lead_time_minutes/1440) as mean_lead_time
  from issues i
    join board_issues bi on i.id = bi.issue_id
  where 
    i.type in (${type})
    and i.status = 'DONE'
    and $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
    and bi.board_id in (${board_id})
  group by 1
)

select 
  time,
  mean_lead_time
from _requirements
order by time asc

panels.title: Mean Issue Lead Time [Issues Resolved in Select Time Range]

panels.description:
1. The cumulative distribution of requirement lead time. 
2. Each point refers to the percent rank of a lead time.

targets.rawSql:
with _ranks as(
  select 
    round(i.lead_time_minutes/1440) as lead_time_day
  from issues i
    join board_issues bi on i.id = bi.issue_id
  where 
    i.type in (${type})
    and i.status = 'DONE'
    and $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
    and bi.board_id in (${board_id})
  order by lead_time_day asc
)

select 
  now() as time,
  lpad(concat(lead_time_day,'d'), 4, ' ') as metric,
  percent_rank() over (order by lead_time_day asc) as value
from _ranks
order by lead_time_day asc

panels.title: Cumulative Distribution of Requirement Lead Time [Issues Resolved in Select Time Range]

panels.description: One row per issue whose merged pull requests have all reached production, and whose production date is in the selected time range. Leave Jira Issue Key empty to list those issues. Set a key such as DEVO-446 to show only that issue; an unreleased issue appears when its merge date is in the range.

targets.rawSql:
with _pr_release as (
  select
    ppm.id as pr_id,
    min(ppm.pr_deployed_date) as released_date
  from project_pr_metrics ppm
  where ppm.pr_deployed_date is not null
  group by ppm.id
),
_linked as (
  select
    i.id as issue_id,
    i.issue_key,
    concat('https://scoretickets.atlassian.net/browse/', i.issue_key) as issue_url,
    i.title,
    i.assignee_name,
    pr.merged_date,
    rel.released_date
  from issues i
    join board_issues bi on bi.issue_id = i.id
    join pull_request_issues pri on pri.issue_id = i.id
    join pull_requests pr on pr.id = pri.pull_request_id and pr.base_repo_id not in (select id from repos where name = 'gotickets/public-web-client')
    left join _pr_release rel on rel.pr_id = pr.id
  where
    i.id like 'jira:%'
    and bi.board_id in (${board_id})
    and i.type in (${type})
    and ('${issue_key}' = '' or i.issue_key = upper(trim('${issue_key}')))
),
_stories as (
  select
    issue_id,
    issue_key,
    max(issue_url) as issue_url,
    max(title) as title,
    max(assignee_name) as assignee_name,
    max(released_date) as released_date,
    max(merged_date) as merged_date,
    sum(merged_date is not null and released_date is null) as unreleased_merged_prs
  from _linked
  group by issue_id, issue_key
)
select
  issue_key as 'Story',
  issue_url,
  title as 'Title',
  assignee_name as 'Assignee',
  released_date as 'Released to Production'
from _stories
where (
  '${issue_key}' != ''
  or (unreleased_merged_prs = 0 and released_date is not null)
)
  and (
    (released_date is not null and $__timeFilter(released_date))
    or (released_date is null and $__timeFilter(merged_date))
  )
 
order by released_date desc
limit 500

panels.title: Stories Released to Production

panels.description: Raw DORA cycle time for each production pull request behind the released issues, limited to the selected time range. Leave the issue key empty to list all of them. Set a key to show only that issue.

targets.rawSql:
with _pr_release as (
  select
    ppm.id as pr_id,
    min(ppm.pr_deployed_date) as released_date,
    min(ppm.pr_coding_time) as pr_coding_time,
    min(ppm.pr_pickup_time) as pr_pickup_time,
    min(ppm.pr_review_time) as pr_review_time,
    min(ppm.pr_deploy_time) as pr_deploy_time,
    min(ppm.pr_cycle_time) as pr_cycle_time
  from project_pr_metrics ppm
  where ppm.pr_deployed_date is not null
  group by ppm.id
),
_linked as (
  select
    i.id as issue_id,
    i.issue_key,
    concat('https://scoretickets.atlassian.net/browse/', i.issue_key) as issue_url,
    i.title,
    i.assignee_name,
    pr.pull_request_key,
    pr.url as pr_url,
    pr.merged_date,
    rel.released_date,
    rel.pr_coding_time,
    rel.pr_pickup_time,
    rel.pr_review_time,
    rel.pr_deploy_time,
    rel.pr_cycle_time
  from issues i
    join board_issues bi on bi.issue_id = i.id
    join pull_request_issues pri on pri.issue_id = i.id
    join pull_requests pr on pr.id = pri.pull_request_id and pr.base_repo_id not in (select id from repos where name = 'gotickets/public-web-client')
    left join _pr_release rel on rel.pr_id = pr.id
  where
    i.id like 'jira:%'
    and bi.board_id in (${board_id})
    and i.type in (${type})
    and ('${issue_key}' = '' or i.issue_key = upper(trim('${issue_key}')))
),
_released_stories as (
  select
    issue_id,
    max(released_date) as story_released_date
  from _linked
  group by issue_id
  having '${issue_key}' != ''
    or (
      sum(merged_date is not null and released_date is null) = 0
      and max(released_date) is not null
    )
)
select
  l.issue_key as 'Story',
  l.issue_url,
  l.title as 'Title',
  l.assignee_name as 'Assignee',
  concat('#', l.pull_request_key) as 'PR',
  l.pr_url,
  l.released_date as 'Released to Production',
  round(l.pr_coding_time/60, 1) as 'Coding Time (h)',
  round(l.pr_pickup_time/60, 1) as 'Pickup Time (h)',
  round(l.pr_review_time/60, 1) as 'Review Time (h)',
  round(l.pr_deploy_time/60, 1) as 'Deploy Time (h)',
  round(l.pr_cycle_time/60, 1) as 'Cycle Time (h)'
from _linked l
  join _released_stories s on s.issue_id = l.issue_id
where (
  (l.released_date is not null and $__timeFilter(l.released_date))
  or ('${issue_key}' != '' and l.released_date is null and l.merged_date is not null and $__timeFilter(l.merged_date))
)

order by l.released_date desc, l.issue_key, l.pull_request_key
limit 500
